title: Surfline Forecast Confidence vs Go Sessions
dataSources: Rides (`ride:session`), charge sessions (`ride:charge`), ride exports (`ride:export`), surf forecasts (`surf:forecast`), ride incidents (`ride:incident`), segment efforts (`fitness:segment`).
app: Micro-mobility and action-sports telemetry — Onewheel ride exports, legacy Boosted board logs, Surfline forecast snapshots, and Strava segment efforts — streamed to Splunk HEC via vendor exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=surf:forecast spot=* forecast_confidence_pct=* session_started=*
| stats avg(forecast_confidence_pct) as avg_forecast_confidence_pct, count as events by spot
| sort - avg_forecast_confidence_pct
description: Shows average forecast confidence percentage by surf spot for Surfline forecast decisions.
value: Average forecast confidence percentage by surf spot helps compare Surfline forecast decisions across the factors that matter most.
implementation: Capture `forecast_confidence_pct` on `surf:forecast` events and normalize `spot` so Splunk can summarize performance by surf spot.
visualization: Bar chart of average forecast confidence percentage by surf spot.
grandmaExplanation: It reminds the average forecast confidence percentage for each surf spot so you can see what works best for Surfline forecast decisions.
